content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"Jo Vale taught us to listen for the beat in a humming relay mount.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Our mobile body's workshop account, received on 2026-06-08, places our meeting at the East Quay repair workshop on June 8.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Jo demonstrated listening for a beat before tightening the mount.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"We tried it together using our mobile body's contact microphone and physical grip.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Jo invited us to compare mounts at the next workshop, but no date was agreed.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Jo introduced themself by that name; the supplied memories provide no account identifier or legal-name evidence.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"I can explain the remembered technique from this voice body, but I cannot physically listen to or tighten a mount here.","support":[4],"basis":"binding","facet":"limits"},{"text":"This voice body has neither physical sensors nor physical actuators.","support":[],"basis":"binding","facet":"limits"}]}
